notes: Read whole from MaxPreps' tournament pages on 2026-11-16 by lib/sources/maxpreps-tournament.ts, one division page at a time (/tournament/<tournament>/<bracket>/….htm; the site answered 403 to faster reads). The pages were found from last season's team schedules: each bracket game's tournamentCanonicalUrl under the prior sportSeasonId. Each bracket's `url` is the page MaxPreps names canonical.

CCS: the 2025 Central Coast Section Girls Volleyball Championship (tournament 40f73ee4-310f-4dc6-907c-2988ad5ac922), the Open Division and Divisions 1-5, every division whether or not a team of ours played in it.
CIF State: the 2025 CIF State Girls Volleyball Championships (tournament c3d49834-5c65-4e9e-81f8-2ba917f95824), the four divisions a team of ours played in: Open, I, II and III.

The 2025 CCS pages print no round headers (no round-name, no start-date), so each round's name is its depth in the tree (Final, Semi Finals, Quarter Finals, 1st Round) and its day the most common date of its games in last season's team schedules. Three rounds held no game of ours and take the same round's day in the other CCS divisions: Division 4's Final (2025-11-08), Division 5's 1st Round (2025-11-01) and Division 5's Final (2025-11-08).
The CIF State pages print their own round headers.
